scene.bubble: Forty-five units! The Explorers did it! Party at the lighthouse — and Pip turns on the great light for us!
scene.intro: Forty-five units — the Lighthouse Explorers did it! There is a party at the lighthouse tonight: balloons on the stairs, music, and a certificate with a golden star for every explorer. Freya, Nico, Astrid and Tomás sing and dance, and Pip stands on the top of the lighthouse like a tiny lamp. They are proud, and they are friends. And YOU did it too. Come and celebrate!

data.script: Freya: Welcome to the lighthouse party! Forty-five units — we did it! … Nico: There is a big cake with a lighthouse on top! … Astrid: Every explorer gets a certificate with a golden star. … Tomas: And we dance the moving song one more time! … Freya: Look up! Pip is turning on the great light! … Nico: The sea is all bright! … Everyone: One, two, three… HOORAY FOR THE EXPLORERS!
